# Operations Specialist 

 Reposted 2 Months Ago 

 6 Locations 

Remote

Mid level

Pet • Retail

The Role

Hands-on operations role managing inventory, vendors, purchase orders, shipments, and inventory-related bookkeeping. Process invoices and 3-way matches, reconcile inventory, apply landed costs, maintain accurate financial and operational data in QuickBooks/Xero and spreadsheets, build process improvements/automations, and support cross-functional expansion projects.

Summary Generated by Built In

Operations Specialist

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time

Obsessed with fixing broken systems? We need a problem-solver who can bring structure to chaos, keep operations running smoothly, and build better ways of doing things every day. This is a hands-on role where execution, accuracy, and continuous improvement are non-negotiable.

About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate at scale across Amazon, Shopify, and retail, and we are constantly building internal systems to support that growth. Operations is not a support function here—it is a core driver of efficiency and scale. The work you do directly impacts how fast and effectively the company runs. If you want to work in an environment where problems get solved fast and systems are constantly improving, this is the place.

The Role

This is a hands-on execution role. You will manage day-to-day operational processes while continuously improving them. Your job is not just to execute tasks, but to identify inefficiencies, fix them, and build systems that prevent them from happening again.

You will work across inventory, data, and operational workflows—ensuring accuracy, reliability, and efficiency at every step.

This is not a passive or repetitive role. You are here to take ownership, solve problems, and make operations better over time.

This Role Is For You If:

- You enjoy organizing systems and making them work
- You naturally spot inefficiencies and think of ways to improve them
- You like building processes, not just following them
- You are detail-oriented and care deeply about accuracy
- You take ownership of problems and follow through until they are solved
- You are comfortable working independently and figuring things out

This Role Is NOT For You If:

- You prefer strictly defined tasks with no ambiguity
- You need constant direction or supervision
- You are comfortable letting errors or inconsistencies go unresolved
- You focus only on completing tasks instead of improving systems

Operations Execution

- Manage and maintain accurate records across vendors, purchase orders, shipments, and product data
- Process inventory invoices and perform 3-way matching with purchase orders
- Support monthly inventory reconciliations and resolve discrepancies
- Apply landed costs to shipments and inventory transfers

Data Accuracy & System Reliability

- Ensure accuracy and consistency across operational and financial data
- Maintain clean and reliable data across spreadsheets and internal systems
- Identify inconsistencies, gaps, and errors across workflows

Process Improvement & System Building

- Continuously improve workflows to reduce manual work and inefficiencies
- Build simple systems, automations, or processes to increase efficiency
- Document processes clearly so they can be scaled and repeated

Cross-Functional Support

- Support wholesale, retail, and operational expansion initiatives
- Assist with ad-hoc projects including research, reporting, and coordination
- Collaborate across teams to ensure smooth execution

Bookkeeping Support

- Support bookkeeping and month-end processes related to inventory
- Work within tools like QuickBooks Online to maintain accurate records

# Privacy policy

This Privacy Policy describes how uprootlint.com (the “Site” or “we”) collects, uses, and discloses your Personal Information when you visit or make a purchase from the Site.

# Collecting Personal Information

When you visit the Site, we collect certain information about your device, your interaction with the Site, and information necessary to process your purchases. We may also collect additional information if you contact us for customer support. In this Privacy Policy, we refer to any information that can uniquely identify an individual (including the information below) as “Personal Information”. See the list below for more information about what Personal Information we collect and why.

Device information

- Examples of Personal Information collected: version of web browser, IP address, time zone, cookie information, what sites or products you view, search terms, and how you interact with the Site.
- Purpose of collection: to load the Site accurately for you, and to perform analytics on Site usage to optimize our Site.
- Source of collection: Collected automatically when you access our Site using cookies, log files, web beacons, tags, or pixels/
- Disclosure for a business purpose: shared with our processor Shopify.

Order information

- Examples of Personal Information collected: name, billing address, shipping address, payment information (including credit card numbers), email address, and phone number.
- Purpose of collection: to provide products or services to you to fulfill our contract, to process your payment information, arrange for shipping, and provide you with invoices and/or order confirmations, communicate with you, screen our orders for potential risk or fraud, and when in line with the preferences you have shared with us, provide you with information or advertising relating to our products or services.
- Source of collection: collected from you.
- Disclosure for a business purpose: shared with our processor Shopify

When you purchase something from our store, as part of the buying and selling process, we collect the personal information you give us such as your name, address and email address.

When you browse our store, we also automatically receive your computer’s internet protocol (IP) address in order to provide us with information that helps us learn about your browser and operating system.

Email marketing (if applicable): With your permission, we may send you emails about our store, new products and other updates.

Text marketing (if applicable): With your permission, we may send text messages about our store, new products, and other updates. Updates include Checkout Reminders. Webhooks will be used to trigger the Checkout Reminders messaging system.

## Text Program

By providing your mobile phone number and opting into the Uproot Lint texting program, you consent to receive text messages from Uproot Lint for promotional and marketing purposes, including but not limited to special offers, product updates, order notifications, and other brand-related communications.

You may opt out of our program at any time by replying to any message with STOP. Once you do so, you will no longer receive text messages from Uproot Lint, unless you choose to opt back in at a later date.

Message frequency may vary. You understand that standard message and data rates may apply, depending on your mobile carrier, and you are responsible for any such charges.

If you have any questions or concerns about our texting program, you can reply to any message with HELP, or contact us at help@uprootclean.com

Text messaging No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties, except for vendors and aggregators that assist us in delivering text messages to you. Shipping policy – Uproot Clean

# Shipping policy

Order Processing

In-stock orders are processed within 1-3 business days (excluding weekends and holidays) after you receive your order confirmation email. Orders containing presale or out-of-stock items will ship once all items are available, and we'll email you when your order is ready to ship. You'll receive a shipping notification email with tracking once your order goes out.

How do I check the status of my order?

When your order has shipped, you'll receive an email notification with a tracking number. Please allow 48 hours for tracking information to become available. If you haven't received your order within 5 business days of your shipping confirmation email, contact us at help@uprootclean.com with your name and order number and we'll look into it.

Payment and Presale Orders

Payment is collected at the time you place your order, including for presale and backordered items.

Address updates

If you made a mistake in your shipping address at checkout, please reach out to us as soon as possible. Our team will do their best to update it before your order ships. If your package has already shipped, we may not be able to make changes, and you'll need to contact the shipping carrier directly to request an address update.

Shipping to P.O. Boxes

Some carriers have limitations around shipping to P.O. Boxes. If your address is a P.O. Box, please check with your carrier regarding their policy before ordering.

Domestic Shipping Rates and Estimates

Shipping charges for your order will be calculated and displayed at checkout.

International Shipping

International shipping is currently available to the United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia. Shipping rates for international orders will be calculated at checkout; duties and taxes may apply.

Who handles your international shipping?

We've partnered with Passport Global, Inc. together with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and / or nominated agents (“Passport”) to facilitate the sale and delivery of orders to international markets. Passport has a number of shipping partners around the world that handle your local delivery and ensure your package arrives safely and quickly. By placing an order on our website, you agree to the referenced terms of sale for these markets.

Do I have to pay duties and taxes?

To create a better delivery experience for you, we offer Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) shipping to some of our international customers. By shipping DDP, duties and taxes are collected directly at checkout so that your package is less likely to be stopped at customs. Please note that duties and taxes assessed by customs vary by country and product. Delivered Duty Paid is not available to all countries, however, we do still offer Delivered Duty Unpaid shipping to the countries found on this page where duties and taxes may get assessed by customs prior to receiving a package.

Returns and Refunds

We accept returns up to 30 days after delivery. Customers are responsible for return shipping costs, and original shipping fees are non-refundable.

International Returns

International orders are eligible for returns within 30 days of delivery. Customers are responsible for arranging and paying for return shipping. Original shipping fees, customs duties, and import taxes are non-refundable.

Damaged Items

If your order arrives damaged, please email us as soon as possible at help@uprootclean.com with your order number and a photo of the item's condition. We handle these cases individually and will work toward a satisfactory solution.

Updated 10/23/2026

3900 Crown Rd SE SW, Atlanta, GA 30304

Senior Accountant at Caldera + Lab | Apply now! – Vaia – Talents

# Senior Accountant 

 Full-Time On-site 

About Caldera + Lab: Caldera + Lab is a premium skincare brand for men and one of the fastest-growing DTC startups in the US. Backed by Series A funding and recognized on BeautyMatter's 2025 Future50 list, we're entering an exciting new chapter as we redefine men's skincare with innovative products and a growth-driven, entrepreneurial team culture.

Candidates should take the time to read all the elements of this job advert carefully Please make your application promptly.

About the Role:

We're looking for a dual-threat Senior Accountant: a strong technical accountant with hands-on, in-house operating experience who can own the close, inventory accounting, and compliance end to end, and who is equally comfortable using AI tools (Claude) to automate and accelerate the work. You'll own day-to-day accounting operations and financial reporting, keep our internal controls tight, and help drive the compounding efficiency gains that let Finance support the broader business — not just run a close.

What You'll Work On: Close & Financial ReportingOwn the monthly close end to end — journal entries, accruals, balance sheet reconciliations, and variance analysis — delivering accurate GAAP financials on time.

Maintain general ledger integrity; support cash flow reporting, monthly financial reviews, and annual audit and tax requests.

Accounting Operations & ComplianceRun AP and AR, including vendor invoices, and employee reimbursements; reconcile bank, credit card, and loan accounts.

Support multi-state sales tax and payroll tax compliance; maintain audit-ready documentation and internal controls; oversee third-party accounting resources.

Inventory AccountingOwn inventory reconciliations, valuation, COGS, and related adjustments across 3PLs and sales channels (Shopify, Amazon, retail) without relying on outside inventory support.

Partner with Operations and Supply Chain to resolve discrepancies and keep inventory accounting accurate.

Systems, AI & Process ImprovementUse Claude and other AI tools to automate recurring workflows, reporting, and analysis — and keep finding the next efficiency gain.

Support integrations across QuickBooks Online, Shopify, Amazon, Ramp, and other platforms; document procedures and strengthen controls as we scale.

Collaborate with other departments on cross-functional issues, ad hoc analysis, and budgeting and forecasting support.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's in Accounting, Finance, or related field; 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, the majority in-house at an operating company.

Hands-on experience booking Shopify and Amazon activity into the GL, including payouts, fees, returns, and reserves (strongly preferred).In-house experience at a CPG or eCommerce brand preferred, ideally one with a larger or more complex SKU catalog than ours.

Deep command of GAAP and the month-end close; hands-on inventory and COGS accounting experience preferred.

Fluency with AI tools (e.g., Claude) applied to accounting and finance work, and a drive to automate and improve.

Advanced Excel and Google Sheets; QuickBooks Online experience preferred.

Multi-state sales tax compliance experience preferred.

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with clear written and verbal communication.

About Us – Caldera + Lab

# EFFICACY. DISCIPLINE. RESULTS.

## We create high-performance skincare designed for men, backed by science and built for impact.

 

## Born from the Legacy of a Caldera

At Caldera + Lab, we draw inspiration from the incredible resilience of nature and the meticulous precision of science. This is how we have approached product development since 2019. Our routines are as effective as they are easy to use. From nature, powered by biotech, with proven clinical efficacy.

Brand Mission

## Men’s Skincare Innovation Was An Oxymoron. We Changed That.

Men’s self-care has long been stagnant when it comes to innovation. We believe skincare should be as forward thinking as the men who use it. Caldera + Lab sets a new standard in the skincare experience for men. We combine uncompromising craftsmanship, state of the art manufacturing, exceptional ingredients with an audited supply chain, and use recyclable and sustainable packaging.

 

 

Brand Vision

## Move Daily. Eat Right. Apply Skincare.

At the heart of what we do is this core belief: skin and hair care are tools that optimize your well-being and health span. High-performance self-care and consistency of a daily regimen can unlock longevity and a new level of personal progress and confidence. Our science serves to support men on this journey.

## Responsible and Transparent From the Start.

Caldera + Lab is committed to Transparency, Sustainability, Excellence. But your trust has to be earned, which is why we have gone the extra mile to become certified by the leading regulatory bodies that assess non-toxicity, social impact, and environmental impact. We proudly embrace accountability.

## Integrity isn’t an accident. It’s a choice.

 

### Made Safe

Caldera + Lab gladly opened our doors for Made Safe’s inspectors to audit our entire production chain. As America’s first non-toxic certification association, they’ve confirmed that we only use non-toxic ingredients in our products, production process, and supply chain. Made Safe is the first association to go beyond organic regulations and the EPA’s registered 85,000 chemicals, to classify toxins that build up over time in our bodies, environment, and oceans.

 

### Leaping Bunny

Leaping Bunny Certification is the international Gold Standard for cosmetics, personal care, animal care, and household products. Their certification confirms that Caldera + Lab has implemented a supplier monitoring system to ensure that our products as well as ingredients are not tested on animals.

 

### rePurpose Global

Certified plastic neutral in partnership with rePurpose Global. With every product we sell, we are financing vetted impact projects that will recover and remove as much plastic waste from the environment as we use in our packaging and operations. In addition to reducing plastic use in our supply chain wherever possible, our partnership with rePurpose Global allows us to create immediate impact on plastic pollution, while supporting ethical wages for often marginalized waste workers.

This refund policy applies to product sales only and does not apply to Subscriptions.

Caldera + Lab’s science starts with dermatological and clinical research on men’s skin biology. We ensure the formulas we create work optimally for men’s skin. We use a cutting-edge formulation approach, B3OS+™, which combines nature’s most powerful ingredients with biotech practices that enhance efficacy and sustainability. Every formula delivers results, clinically tested on men’s skin and validated with real users. Visit The Science page for more details on our formula development. Where are you located? While our team is based all over the US, most of our team is in Austin, TX and we consider that home. Products How is men’s skin different? The structure, hormones and aging patterns of men’s skin is different from women. Men’s skin is 25% thicker, regulated by testosterone with 2x more oil production and has a higher collagen density. As a result, men’s skin forms deeper wrinkles. Men are also more susceptible to micro-inflammation and skin barrier damage from regular shaving. How long will it take to see results? It varies by product. All of our products are designed to deliver immediate benefits, as well as long-term results. For skincare, you can typically expect to see results after 60 days. We provide a 60-day money back guarantee because we stand behind our products and their results. Remember, consistency is key. The more consistent your skincare routine, the more you will see results. Are your products safe for sensitive skin? All of our formulas are dermatologist tested and made with plant-based, non-irritating ingredients, and without harsh ingredients like sulfates, parabens or synthetic fragrances. A clinical study and an irritancy (RIPT) study on each of our formulas confirms product safety. If you have any concerns or need help choosing the right products for you, our team of in house estheticians can help you. Why should I use a serum? Serum is the most potent, efficacious treatment step in a skincare routine, packed with actives and with a formula texture designed to deeply penetrate skin for visible results. We have two powerhouse serums for different skin types and concerns - The Good and The Great. Take our Skin Analysis or contact our team of estheticians if you need help choosing. What is the difference between The Good and The Great? The Good is ideal for dry skin types, colder climates or as a night treatment for added hydration and recovery. The Great is ideal for normal or oily skin types and can be used morning and night. It is an advanced age renewal serum in a lightweight texture, with proprietary exosomes for sagging skin, loss of elasticity and lines and wrinkles. ## WHEN DID SNACKS BECOME SO COMPLICATED? 

I’ve been in the snack food world for 20 years. Along with my previous co-founder partner and best friend, we created Sahale Snacks and grew it into a household brand. Our claim to fame was reinventing commoditized trail mix with complexity – essentially amazing combinations of ingredients and flavors.

Flash forward, and here I am again with different insights and perspectives. The calling today is for simplicity and snacks that taste closer to their pure and earthly essence. Nothing over-engineered. No fuss, no fillers.

I believe that living authentically and taking time to enjoy life’s simple pleasures is the best way to live–and to snack. What started as a sunflower seed company has blossomed into a genuine passion for taste, quality and community. So sit back, relax, and snack. We’re just getting started.

–Josh Schroeter

# South 40 Snacks raises nearly $6M to grow its seed-based snack line

What's the deal? South 40 Snacks has raised $6 million, according to a Form D filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on August 10. Scott Greenburg, founder and partner at Seattle-based FarPoint Venture Law Dealroom has a profile for this one. Try Dealroom →, joined the company's board alongside the round.

Who's behind it? The company was founded in 2018 by Josh Schroeter, the founder and former chief executive officer of nut mix brand Sahale Snacks Dealroom has a profile for this one. Try Dealroom →. It built its business originally around a variety of sunflower seed snacks.

What's the endgame? The brand's portfolio has since expanded beyond seeds. It now includes nut and seed bars, dried fruit bars, and Craft Bars, which mix nuts, seeds, and spices.

The signal: The raise signals continued investor appetite for better-for-you snacking brands built by proven operators. Schroeter's track record with Sahale Snacks gives the seed-based bet a familiar playbook to build on.

# Inventory Controller

: ### TYPE OF WORK

 Full Time 

: ### WAGE / SALARY

 17000 USD 

: ### HOURS PER WEEK

 40 

: ### DATE UPDATED

 Sep 28, 2026 

 JOB OVERVIEW 

 Inventory Controller Location: Remote — Philippines | Type: Full-time, remote (engaged as an independent contractor) | Level: Individual Contributor | Reports to: Director, Supply Chain Schedule: Core overlap with US business hours required. About Rhino USA Rhino USA is a family-founded brand that designs and sells premium tie-down straps, recovery gear, and outdoor and automotive accessories. We sell across our own storefronts and major marketplaces, ship from multiple domestic and international warehouses, and run our operations on the Fulfil ERP. As we scale across channels and regions, keeping a single, trustworthy view of inventory is mission-critical — and that is exactly what this role owns. The Role We are hiring a detail-obsessed Inventory Controller to be the person who makes our inventory numbers true. You will reconcile stock, movements, and settlement data across every channel and warehouse we operate — Fulfil ERP, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and other marketplaces, our 3PL/WMS feeds, and our international warehouses — and turn a tangle of conflicting reports into one clean, defensible source of truth. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys hunting down a 12-unit discrepancy until they know exactly where it came from. You will not manage a team; you will own the accuracy of the data itself. If you find satisfaction in a reconciliation that ties out to zero, you will fit in well here. What You'll Do Multi-channel reconciliation (the core of the job) Reconcile on-hand, inbound, reserved, and in-transit inventory between Fulfil ERP (our system of record) and every sales channel and warehouse, identifying and resolving every variance. Own channel-level reconciliation across Amazon (Seller & Vendor Central / FBA & FBM), Walmart, TikTok Shop, and our other marketplaces and storefronts — matching stock ledgers, inbound/receiving records, reserved and unfulfillable quantities, and settlement/financial reports back to Fulfil. Reconcile 3PL and warehouse (WMS) feeds — receipts, putaways, picks, adjustments, and cycle counts — against ERP records for both domestic and international warehouses, accounting for multi-currency, multi-location, and customs/in-transit nuances. Investigate root causes of discrepancies (mis-scans, timing/cutoff differences, unmapped SKUs, returns not processed, FX and unit-of-measure mismatches, sync failures) and drive them to resolution rather than just flagging them. Reconcile Amazon and marketplace reimbursements, lost/damaged inventory, and settlement data, and open/track cases to recover what we're owed. Data accuracy & controls Maintain accurate SKU mappings, unit-of-measure conversions, and channel listings so data flows cleanly between systems. Design and run a recurring cycle-count and audit cadence with warehouse partners, and lead investigation of count-to-system variances. Post and document inventory adjustments in Fulfil with clear, auditable notes and supporting evidence. Monitor system syncs and integrations for failures or drift; escalate and follow up until data is aligned again. Reporting & continuous improvement Produce clear, recurring reconciliation reports and inventory-accuracy dashboards for Supply Chain and Finance, with variances quantified and explained. Build and maintain reconciliation workbooks / trackers (advanced spreadsheets, and reporting inside Fulfil) that others can trust and follow. Document repeatable SOPs for every reconciliation process you own, and continuously tighten them to reduce recurring errors. Surface trends and systemic problems (channels or warehouses that drift most, common error types) and recommend process or system fixes. Cross-functional collaboration Work closely with Operations, Finan

About Rhino USA: Family-Owned Since 2015

## ABOUT US 

 

## AMERICAN OWNED, FAMILY OPERATED. 

Rhino USA is a family-owned business founded by a father and two sons from Temecula, California. We design and sell premium truck accessories and off-road adventure gear, all backed by a lifetime guarantee and personalized customer service. We love the outdoors, the freedom of riding motorcycles, going off-roading, boating, hiking, drinking beer around the campfire, and living life to the fullest. Our goal is simple: to help people Worry Less and Adventure More!

## WORRY LESS, ADVENTURE MORE®! 

Whatever it is you love to do, the Rhino Team is 100% committed to helping you blaze your own trail with confidence and to safely adventure where you want, when you want! Worry Less and Adventure More, with Rhino USA!

 

## COMPANY FAQ 

 How long have you been in business? 

Rhino USA was founded in 2015.

 Where are you guys located? 

Our team is based in Austin, Texas, and Woodstock, Georgia:

- 6907 N Capital of Texas Hwy #210 Austin, TX 78731
- 233 Arnold Mill Rd #100 Woodstock, GA 30188

If you're ever in the area, stop in and say hi!

 What type of warranty do you offer? 

We offer an unlimited LIFETIME Warranty on ALL of our products! If you EVER have an issue, simply call our 800# and we will make it right!

 Where are your products made? 

All of our products are designed, engineered and lab tested here in the USA, however, due to the extremely high cost of manufacturing locally, we source raw materials and manufacture overseas in order to keep the cost of our products competitive in our global marketplace.

 Where else can I buy Rhino USA products? 

Our products are for sale on Amazon, TikTok Shop, eBay, Walmart.com and stocked at in-store locations all over the US, Canada and South America. Check out our Store Locator here!

 How do I contact you if I have a question? 

- Call us toll-free at (800) 575-7310 (8005757310), Mon-Fri 9am to 5pm EST

- Submit a contact form here

Rhino USA Dealer Program

 

## THE RHINO DEALER PROGRAM IS TRANSITIONING TO NATIONAL DISTRIBUTORS 

### Existing dealers will still have access to their account and can place orders up until April 30th, 2026.

## Dealer Program Transition FAQ 

 What is changing? 

Rhino USA is transitioning away from the direct dealer program and moving to a national distributor model. 

We are streamlining our operations to better support long-term growth and strengthen our national distribution network. This move allows us to improve inventory positioning, fulfillment speed, and provide broader access through best-in-class distribution partners.

Our business is to make bad ass products….not distribution so we want to work with the experts there to ensure you get RhinoUSA products in the best manner possible!

 What is the last day dealers can place direct orders? 

The final day for existing dealer orders is April 30, 2026.

After this date:

- Shopify wholesale access will be turned off
- Dealers will be directed to purchase through distributors

 Which distributors can potential and new dealers order from? 

We have existing relationships with:

- Meyer Distributing
- Turn 14
- Turn 5
- JB Tools
- Quadratec
- Sunrise Distributors

If you have a national distributor that you work with that you think would be great to sell Rhino products please reach out to: dealers@rhinousainc.com.

 How to get in touch with these new distributors? 

Meyer

- https://www.meyerdistributing.com/Customers/ApplicationTerms.aspx
- Download the new customer application and fill it out. 
- Then email it to CustApps@MeyerDistributing.com. That would get them assigned an account manager.
- Our CURRENT DEALERS can also email Leads.Mailbox@meyerdistributing.com and that will get them assigned an account manager that will call them back and can provide any info they need.

Turn 14

- https://turn14.formstack.com/forms/dealer_application
- Fill out the dealer application. They will then be assigned an account manager.

 Will pricing change? 

Dealers will receive competitive wholesale pricing through our distribution partners.

 What happens to existing orders placed before April 30? 

 All orders placed before April 30 will be fulfilled as normal under current terms.

There will be no disruption to orders already confirmed.

 What happens after April 30 if a dealer tries to log in? 

Wholesale access will be disabled.

The Dealer page on both our Rhino website and Shopify platform will be updated to reflect these changes and will direct dealers to dealers@rhinousainc.com for any questions or support.

 Will Rhino still support warranty or product issues? 

Yes. Rhino USA will continue handling:

- Product warranties
- Product support
- Customer service issues

The change only impacts how dealers purchase inventory.

# [ BDSN ] Born on Amazon but built everywhere else

Jun 11, 2026

### STUMP BEZOS

According to Bluevine, what percentage of small business owners have skipped or reduced their own paycheck?

[ Answer at bottom of email ]

### 👀 BORN ON AMAZON - BUILT EVERYWHERE ELSE

Two kids. A ratchet strap. A dad who stepped in. Here's how Rhino USA turned a family side project into a nine-figure brand and a 182-acre content factory in Texas. In 2015, two brothers had a problem. Cameron and Dylan Repic rode dirt bikes and off-road trucks. They wanted gear that actually held up. Straps, tie-downs, recovery rope. The stuff they used every weekend. So they built their own and listed it on Amazon. That was the plan. Solve their own problem. Sell a few units. See what happens. It worked. Fast. And then it hit the wall every young founder hits, where the passion runs straight into inventory, cash flow, and suppliers. The boring stuff that quietly kills good products. That is the day their dad stepped in. Ted Repic didn't take the brand away from his sons. He guided it. He brought the operating muscle two twenty-somethings didn't have yet. Today he's the CEO of the company his kids started, and it does nine figures a year. Nine figures. From ratchet straps.

 Here is the part every Amazon seller needs to sit with.

Rhino USA was born on Amazon. It refused to stay there. The Amazon channel did exactly what Amazon is good at. It validated the products. It generated cash. It proved real people wanted what these guys were making. Most sellers stop right there. They optimize the listing, chase the BSR, and rent their customers from Amazon forever. Rhino did the opposite. They took the brand everywhere Amazon couldn't follow. They pushed into Walmart, Sam's Club, and AutoZone. They expanded from dirt bikes into towing, camping, boating, and overlanding. Over 300 products now. Sales have quadrupled in three years.\

Then came TikTok Shop, and this is where it gets loud. Rhino joined in October 2023, right after the U.S. launch. Within days they were organically selling thousands of dollars of gear, because their own customers were already filming themselves using it. One retractable ratchet strap turned out to be perfect for short video. Easy to show. Easy to get. One clip using it as a pair of suspenders pulled over a million views. Another, yanking a stranded car out of the ocean surf with a kinetic rope, did close to four million. They have done eight figures on TikTok Shop alone. They're the top seller in the entire automotive and motorcycle category. Last year more than 6,000 creators moved product for them and drove roughly a billion impressions. Sit with that number. A billion impressions for a strap brand. Try buying that on Amazon.

Then they did something most e-commerce founders would never think of. They sponsored bull riding.

Rhino USA went six figures deep into the Professional Bull Riders world. They're the official powersport accessories partner of the Austin Gamblers PBR Team Series. They back top riders like "Mr. 90-Pointer" Dalton Kasel and Australian Callum Miller. Grit, dirt, trucks, adrenaline. The exact customer they want, sitting in front of an audience that will never scroll their Amazon listing.

Now they're building the boldest piece yet. It's called RhinoWorld. 182 acres of Central Texas scrubland outside Austin. Trails, recovery courses, a prototyping lab, a retail store, a campground, an archery range, and eight miles of proving grounds. There's even an 8,000 square foot building going up just for film live shopping. 

"RhinoWorld is our content factory," Repic said.

That's the whole strategy in five words. A physical place built to manufacture the videos, demos, and live streams that feed every channel they sell on. Product overview

Herbal Goodness Hair Growth Plus is a liquid dietary supplement made from bamboo leaf, one of the plant world's richest natural sources of silica. Silica is a trace mineral that plays a part in the body's collagen and connective tissue. This 12oz bottle is a concentrated, alcohol-free extract for daily hair, skin and nail support.*

Key features

  • 15X concentrated bamboo leaf liquid extract
  • Natural plant source of silica
  • Alcohol-free, made with vegetable glycerin and purified water
  • Certified Kosher by Earth Kosher [CONFIRM still current]
  • Made in the USA

Ingredient

  • Bamboo leaf extract (1,000 mg per serving): a natural source of plant silica, traditionally used to support strong hair and nails and healthy skin.
  • Vegetable glycerin and purified water: an alcohol-free base with a mild, slightly sweet taste.

Benefits

  • Supports strong, healthy-looking hair
  • Supports nail strength
  • Supports healthy, radiant-looking skin
  • Supports healthy bones and joints

Suggested use

Shake well. Take 1 tablespoon 2–3 times a day with food mixed into water, tea or juice. Use consistently for 60–90 days. Refrigerate after opening.

Quality & sourcing. Made in the USA and third-party tested for purity and potency. No artificial additives or preservatives.

Why choose Herbal Goodness. We are a women-owned company that believes in Purpose With Profit. We work with growers who use sustainable practices, and 10% of our profits support education for underserved girls and women in Africa.

# Accounting & Operations Lead - Herbal Goodness

Remote, USA Posted 2026-07-26 Full-time

 Company: Herbal Goodness Location: Remote Department: Finance & Operations Reports To: CEO About Herbal Goodness Herbal Goodness is a fast-growing wellness company committed to providing premium herbal teas, liquid extracts, superfoods, and supplements that support healthy living and transform lives. We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and execution-focused Accounting, Finance & Operations Lead to strengthen our financial discipline, improve operational efficiency, and support scalable growth across e-commerce, warehouse, and supply chain functions. Position Summary The Finance & Operations Lead will play a critical role at the intersection of bookkeeping, financial reporting, e-commerce operations, inventory management, and process improvement. This person will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, driving timely reconciliations, supporting decision-making with data, and partnering cross-functionally to improve business performance. This role is ideal for a candidate who is strong in QuickBooks, account reconciliations, reporting, Excel, bookkeeping, and operational follow-through, and who thrives in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment. Key Responsibilities Accounting, Financial Management & Bookkeeping Support leadership with accounting, bookkeeping, financial management, analysis, and weekly/monthly reporting Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable Reconcile bank accounts, credit card accounts, and other balance sheet accounts accurately and on time Reconcile E-Commerce channels' deposits in QuickBooks Online Maintain accurate bookkeeping records and ensure clean financial data for decision-making Assist with financial statement preparation, account analysis, and balance reporting Support tax-related recordkeeping and coordination with external accountants as needed Help improve the chart of accounts structure, classifications, and financial controls Operations & E-Commerce Management Manage key aspects of e-commerce operations, including: Demand Planning and Forecasting Purchase orders & receiving Inventory control Shipping and logistics Monitor operational workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce errors Drive purchasing decisions, working closely with warehouse and operations teams to develop reports on inventory levels and prevent stockouts or excess inventory Help manage warehouse-related activities across multiple locations, including: Own warehouse, Texas Fulfillment by Amazon/Walmart (FBA)/FBW Support freight, import/export, and vendor coordination activities Inventory, Reporting & KPI Management Track, analyze, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) across finance and operations Build and maintain reports that provide visibility into inventory, purchasing, fulfillment, and financial health Monitor inventory levels and support timely replenishment to maximize sales opportunities Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, operations, customer service, and purchasing, to align data and action plans Identify trends, discrepancies, and areas for corrective action Process Improvement Support cross-functional process improvement initiatives to ensure company objectives are achieved Help establish systems, templates, and reporting discipline across the finance and operations team Participate in onboarding and performance review initiatives Support the creation of training processes, operational documentation, and accountability systems Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field preferred 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, financial operations, accounting, or finance/operations coordination Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel Demonstrated experience with: Account reconciliation AP/AR man

# Controller

 Rho Nutrition Stati Uniti d'America

### Usa l’IA per valutare se hai un profilo adeguato

Department: Finance

Location: Remote - US 

Description About Rho Nutrition Rho Nutrition was founded to bring integrity and innovation to supplement manufacturing by prioritizing medically studied, high-quality formulations. Our products feature clinically proven ingredients using next-generation bio-delivery technologies to enhance cellular-level absorption and drive measurable health benefits. Founded with the vision to deliver unparalleled cellular absorption, we focus on transparency, effectiveness, and empowering individuals to understand and optimize their supplementation. Rho is committed to advancing the science behind wellness and helping customers invest in their health with efficacy-driven solutions. Operating across Shopify DTC, Amazon, and national retail, Rho serves hundreds of thousands of customers and is scaling rapidly while maintaining our strict standards. Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on Controller to own Rho's accounting operations. Reporting to the VP of Finance, you will run the close, safeguard the integrity of our financial statements, lead tax and audit readiness, and build the processes, controls, and systems a fast-growing, multi-channel CPG business needs. This is a working leader role: you will set direction for the accounting function and coach a small team, while staying close enough to the detail to review reconciliations, post entries, and solve problems yourself. You will also be a trusted business partner to Operations, Sales, and Leadership. Key Responsibilities Close & Financial Reporting 

- Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, with a target of closing within three business days.
- Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepaids, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
- Deliver accurate, GAAP-compliant monthly financial statements and management reporting packages.
- Maintain general ledger integrity through regular balance sheet reviews and account analyses.
- Develop and maintain accounting policies and technical accounting guidance. 

Revenue, Inventory & Cost Accounting 

- Reconcile revenue and COGS across Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, wholesale distributors, and retail in accordance with ASC 606.
- Own inventory and cost accounting, including inventory balances, adjustments, and COGS reconciliations.
- Ensure accurate accounting for customer deductions, rebates, promotional allowances, and chargebacks. 

Accounts Payable, Receivable & Payroll 

- Oversee AP and AR, including wholesale invoicing, collections, vendor onboarding, W-9/W-8 collection, and annual 1099 reporting.
- Review weekly AR aging and work with customers to resolve payment disputes, deductions, and chargebacks.
- Oversee semi-monthly payroll in Rippling and review payroll reports for accuracy and compliance. 

Tax Compliance 

- Own multi-state sales tax compliance: review filings prepared through Numeral, upload monthly.
- Partner with external advisors on federal, state, and local income tax compliance and planning.
- Prepare tax schedules and documentation, and track and resolve tax notices. 

Audit & Internal Controls 

- Serve as the primary accounting contact for external auditors and lead audit preparation, schedules, and requests.
- Design, document, and maintain internal controls that keep pace with the company's growth.
- Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, company policies, and regulatory requirements. 

Systems & Process Improvement 

- Lead implementation of an ERP as we scale beyond QuickBooks Online, then drive its ongoing optimization.
- Identify and deliver automation and process improvements that increase speed, accuracy, and scalability. 

Leadership & Partnership 

- Supervise, train, and develop junior accountants handling bank and credit card re

# Third-Party Marketplace Sales Prohibition Policy

This Third-Party Marketplace Sales Prohibition Policy (the “Policy”) governs the sale, distribution, and resale of all products offered by Rho Nutrition (the “Products”).

### 1. Absolute Prohibition on Marketplace Sales

The sale, listing, offering for sale, distribution, or advertising of Rho Nutrition Products on any third-party online marketplace is strictly prohibited.

This includes, without limitation:

- Amazon
- Walmart
- eBay
- Any other online marketplace, auction platform, or third-party resale channel

This prohibition applies worldwide and without exception.

### 2. Binding Agreement and Acceptance

This Policy is incorporated by reference into all agreements between Rho Nutrition and any purchaser, reseller, distributor, retailer, affiliate, or partner (each, a “Partner”).

By purchasing, reselling, distributing, or otherwise dealing in Rho Nutrition Products, each Partner:

- Acknowledges receipt of this Policy

Where to Buy Rho Supplements – Rho Nutrition 

# Where to Buy Rho Supplements 

You’ve done the research. You understand why delivery format matters. Now you just want to make sure you’re getting the real thing.

That’s where things can get unnecessarily complicated.

Search for Rho supplements and you’ll find multiple storefronts, listings, and resellers claiming to carry the same products. Some are legitimate. Some are not. And when you’re dealing with liposomal formulations, how a product is stored and handled isn’t a small detail—it directly impacts quality.

This guide breaks down where to buy Rho supplements, where to find them in-store, and how to avoid the common pitfalls that come with third-party sellers.

## The Best Place to Buy Rho Supplements

If you want the most straightforward option, buy directly from the official Rho website.

That removes the guesswork entirely.

When you purchase through Rho’s official store, you’re getting products that come straight from the source—without sitting in unknown warehouses or passing through multiple resellers.

There are also practical advantages:

- Full product selection Every Rho supplement, bundle, and new release is available in one place.
- Fresh inventory Products are shipped directly, reducing the risk of extended storage time.
- Subscription options If you’re using supplements consistently, auto-ship can simplify the process and often reduce cost over time.
- Direct customer support Questions are handled by the team behind the products—not a third-party seller.
- Satisfaction policies Official guarantees and return options typically apply only to direct purchases.

If your goal is consistency—same product, same quality, every time—buying direct is the cleanest solution.

## Where to Buy Rho Supplements In-Store

If you prefer to shop in person, Rho supplements are also available through select retail partners.

You can find Rho products at stores like:

- Sprouts Farmers Market
- GNC
- Lassens Natural Foods & Vitamins
- Erewhon Market
- The Vitamin Shoppe
- Kimberton Whole Foods

Availability can vary by location, so it’s worth checking ahead of time.

For the most accurate and up-to-date list of retailers near you, use the official store locator: https://rhonutrition.com/pages/store-locator

Buying in-store gives you the benefit of immediate access—no shipping wait—and allows you to see products firsthand. Just keep in mind that selection may be more limited compared to the full online catalog.

## Can You Buy Rho on Amazon or Other Retailers?

This is where things get less clear—and where most issues tend to happen.

You may come across Rho products on marketplaces like Amazon or other third-party platforms. The key question isn’t whether they exist there—it’s who is actually selling them and how they’ve been handled.

With liposomal supplements, that matters more than most people think.

These formulations are more sensitive than standard capsules or tablets. Factors like temperature, light exposure, and storage time can affect stability. Once products move outside controlled distribution, those variables become harder to track.

Potential risks with unauthorized or unclear sellers include:

- Unknown storage conditions
- Extended time sitting in warehouses
- No guarantee of authenticity
- Limited or no access to brand-backed support or return policies

This doesn’t mean every third-party listing is problematic. But it does mean you’re relying on information you can’t fully verify.

If consistency and product integrity matter to you, buying direct—or through trusted retail partners—is the safer move.

## How to Spot Fake or Expired Supplements

Not every issue is obvious at first glance. Packaging can look legitimate, and listings can appear polished. But there are a few ways to reduce your risk.

Authentic products typically have:

- Clean, consistent labeling

# Accounting Manager - CPG & E-Commerce

 Remote, USA Posted Oct 31, 2026 Full-time $50K–$70K/yr

About Rho Nutrition 

Rho Nutrition was founded to bring integrity and innovation to supplement manufacturing by prioritizing medically studied, high-quality formulations. Our products feature clinically proven ingredients using next-generation bio-delivery technologies to enhance cellular-level absorption and drive measurable health benefits. Founded with the vision to deliver unparalleled cellular absorption, we focus on transparency, effectiveness, and empowering individuals to understand and optimize their supplementation. Rho is committed to advancing the science behind wellness and helping customers invest in their health with efficacy-driven solutions. Operating across Shopify DTC, WFH Beacon, and national retail, Rho serves hundreds of thousands of customers and is scaling rapidly while maintaining our strict standards. Role Overview We are seeking a hands-on Accounting Manager to join our growing finance team. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting, maintaining strong accounting controls, and supporting the rapid growth of a multi-channel CPG business. The Accounting Manager will own the month-end close process, oversee key accounting functions, mentor junior staff, and drive process improvements across the organization. The ideal candidate has experience in consumer packaged goods (CPG), inventory accounting, and e-commerce operations, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This is a working manager position requiring both strategic thinking and daily execution.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead and organize the month-end close process, achieving a close within three business days. 
- Reconcile revenue and cost of goods sold (COGS) across Shopify, WFH Beacon Seller Central, wholesale distributors, and other sales channels in accordance with ASC 606. 
- Maintain the general ledger, including journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and account reconciliations. 
- Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, wholesale customer invoicing, collections, vendor onboarding, W-9/W-8 collection, and annual 1099 reporting. 
- Review weekly accounts receivable aging reports and partner with customers to resolve payment disputes, deductions, and chargebacks. 
- Supervise and train junior accountants responsible for bank reconciliations, credit card reconciliations, customer payment applications, and other daily accounting functions. 
- Review customer deductions, rebates, promotional allowances, and chargebacks to ensure accurate accounting treatment. 
- Manage inventory accounting and reconcile inventory balances, inventory adjustments, and cost of goods sold. 
- Oversee sales tax compliance across multiple states, including reviewing filings prepared by Numeral, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring timely filing and payment. 
- Prepare and upload wholesale sales data to Numeral monthly. 
- Process semi-monthly payroll through Rippling and review payroll reports for accuracy and compliance. 
- Maintain compliance with U.S. GAAP, company policies, and internal controls. 
- Support audits and tax engagements by preparing schedules and responding to auditor requests. 
- Mentor and develop junior accounting staff through coaching, performance feedback, and delegation of responsibilities. 
- Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and scalability as the company continues to grow. 
- Partner cross-functionally with Operations and Sales, and Leadership teams on projects that improve financial visibility and operational efficiency.

- Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field. 
- Minimum 6 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 3 years in a CPG, food & beverage, dietary supplement, manufacturing, or e-commerce environment.

Controller at Bask & Lather

# Controller

 New York, U.S. Full-Time Remote $175,000 – $195,000 per year 

 This job is no longer available and isn't accepting applications. 

## TLDR

Build scalable accounting processes across NetSuite, inventory, and multichannel revenue operations while supporting retail expansion.

About Bask & Lather Co.

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, scalp-first textured haircare company serving customers across direct-to-consumer, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and major retail channels. We are a lean, entrepreneurial organization that moves quickly, operates with high ownership, and expects team members to turn priorities into action without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

Role Overview

The Controller will own the accounting function end-to-end and serve as the backbone of financial integrity, reporting, and operational discipline. This role will partner closely with the Head of Finance to build scalable processes and support retail expansion.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring both execution and system-building.

1. Financial Close and Reporting

- Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
- Establish a path to preliminary financial reporting within five business days and a complete, supportable close within ten business days.
- Prepare accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial statements.
- Own balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals, reserves, account substantiation, and financial-statement support.
- Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready documentation.
- Develop and maintain the accounting calendar, close checklist, and departmental deadlines.
- Coordinate external audit and tax requirements.
- Identify accounting issues proactively and present clear recommendations to the Head of Finance.

2. Inventory, COGS, and Gross-Margin Integrity

- Own inventory accounting across manufacturers, 3PLs, marketplaces, retail channels, and DTC operations.
- Reconcile inventory monthly among the general ledger, NetSuite, 3PL records, retailer activity, and internal inventory schedules.
- Establish reliable standard costs, landed costs, manufacturing variances, and SKU-level COGS.
- Own accounting for inventory in transit, shrinkage, obsolescence, damaged inventory, reserves, and write-offs.
- Partner with Supply Chain on purchase-order receipts, freight accruals, vendor reconciliations, and cycle-count controls.
- Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies promptly.
- Improve gross-margin visibility by SKU, product category, channel, and customer.
- Ensure inventory accounting policies and valuation methodologies are consistently documented and applied.

3. Revenue and Channel Accounting

- Own revenue accounting and settlement reconciliation across Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Walmart, wholesale, and other marketplace and retail channels.
- Ensure appropriate revenue recognition, cutoff, and channel-level reporting.
- Reconcile platform settlements, transaction fees, refunds, returns, reserves, receivables, and cash receipts.
- Own accounting for retailer deductions, chargebacks, promotions, markdowns, allowances, and trade spend.
- Ensure accurate gross-to-net and contra-revenue treatment.
- Build controls to identify missing payments, invalid deductions, unreimbursed claims, and settlement discrepancies.
- Partner with Commercialization, E-Commerce, Customer Experience, and Supply Chain to resolve channel and retailer discrepancies.
- Maintain reliable supporting schedules for retail receivables, marketplace settlements, returns, and deductions.

4. Cash, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and Working Capital

- Oversee the accounts receivable and accounts payable functions, including management and development of the existing AP/AR Specialist.
- Maintain accurate daily and weekly cash reporting.
- Support short- and long-term cash-flow forecasting.

# Jackson Jones

Founder & CEO at Farm to Pet | Scale & Operations Executive | Former VP of Supply Chain (Duracell & Marmon Group) | Single-Ingredient Pet Nutrition

Chicago, Illinois, United States (US)

500 connections • 2,802 followers

## About

I’m the founder and CEO of Farm to Pet, but I’ve always been a “hands-on” operator. My career is rooted in the belief that the best outcomes—whether in global supply chains or pet nutrition—come from understanding the details, embracing systematic improvement, and good old fashioned hard work. My journey here wasn't a straight line. Growing up working on my grandparents’ farm in rural Illinois, I learned early on that ingenuity, sustainability, and hard work are the foundations of any good business. That upbringing instilled in me a lifelong love for nature and a drive to solve problems, which eventually led me to a career in operations. Over the last two decades, I’ve had the privilege of scaling operations for industry leaders, progressing from a tech analyst at Caterpillar to a global supply chain VP at Berkshire Hathaway companies like Duracell and the Marmon Group. Those years were an incredible masterclass in Lean principles, capital efficiency, and navigating complex logistical landscapes. I saw firsthand how 80/20 principles, innovation and operational rigor could transform a business. Eventually, the "entrepreneurial voice" became too loud to ignore. I founded Farm to Pet to bridge the gap between institutional supply chain expertise and the need for simple, transparent, and healthy pet nutrition. We started experimenting with our signature dog treats in 2020 from the basement of our Chicago home, with my wife, our children, and our rescue dog, Rooney (our official treat taster), by my side. Today, Farm to Pet has grown into a community of over 100,000 supportive, pet-loving customers. We operate our manufacturing and distribution facility, allowing us to maintain complete control over our quality and supply chain. By keeping production local and focusing on human-grade, single-ingredient treats, we’ve proven that you can be ethical, sustainable, and highly efficient at the same time. I’m incredibly proud of the impact we’ve had on thousands of dogs and cats so far, but we’re just getting started. Whether it’s through our partnerships, our commitment to clean proteins, or our next stage of growth, I am dedicated to bringing real transparency to the pet industry. I love connecting with fellow pet parents, entrepreneurs, technologists and supply chain leaders. Feel free to reach out—I’d love to share more about our mission to help pets live happier, healthier lives.

Total Experience: 25 years and 6 months

June 01, 2026

# Inventory Accountant

About Naked Nutrition

Founded in 2014, Naked Nutrition is a direct-to-consumer supplement brand built around radical transparency - minimal ingredients, no artificial additives, and nothing to hide. With over 1 million customers, 50K+ five-star reviews, and distribution across Shopify Plus, Amazon, and Walmart, we're a proven brand with significant room to grow. This is a rare opportunity to join a lean, founder-led team and have genuine ownership over a high-impact channel.

The Role

The Inventory Accountant is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of inventory, purchasing, and supply chain-related financial transactions for Naked Nutrition. This role serves as the primary link between Accounting, Operations, and third-party logistics providers (3PLs), ensuring inventory movements, receipts, invoices, and costs are properly recorded and reconciled in NetSuite.

 The ideal candidate combines strong accounting fundamentals with operational awareness and has experience managing inventory reconciliations, investigating discrepancies, and supporting month-end close activities within a fast-paced consumer packaged goods (CPG) environment. 

What You'll Own

Program strategy & growth Build and scale our affiliate program - platform selection, structure, commission tiers, and performance targets across the US, Canada, UK, and EU.

Creator & influencer recruitment Identify, pitch, and onboard fitness, wellness, and lifestyle creators - from nano-influencers to major partners - across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and podcasts.

Partner relationship management Act as the primary contact for all affiliate and creator partners. Drive activation, content output, and long-term retention through proactive relationship building.

Content & campaign coordination Brief partners on product launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand messaging. Ensure content aligns with the Naked Nutrition voice and clean-label positioning.

Performance analytics & reporting Own the data: track clicks, conversions, CAC, and attributed revenue by partner and channel. Present clear ROI reporting and optimization recommendations monthly.

International market expansion Develop region-specific strategies for Canada, the UK, and EU - including local platform differences, creator markets, and compliance considerations (FTC, ASA).

Key Responsibilities

- Reconcile inventory balances across ERP system (NetSuite) and 3PL partners.
- Investigate and resolve inventory, receiving, and cost discrepancies.
- Support Accounts Payable with inventory-related invoice reviews.
- Review purchase orders, receipts, and invoices to ensure accurate three-way matching.
- Ensure transactions and invoices are properly coded to the appropriate business unit and general ledger accounts.
- Prepare inventory and balance sheet reconciliations and support month-end close activities.
- Review and process inventory adjustments, write-offs, transfers, and cycle count variances.
- Support inventory valuation, landed cost allocations, and cost of goods sold reporting.
- Partner with Operations, Procurement, and warehouse teams to improve inventory accuracy and strengthen internal controls.
- Assist with audit requests and maintain supporting documentation for inventory-related transactions.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
- 3+ years of NetSuite accounting experience with inventory-related responsibilities.
- Strong understanding of inventory accounting principles and account reconciliations.
- Experience in CPG, food & beverage, supplements, manufacturing, or distribution industries.
- Experience managing inventory across multiple warehouses or 3PL providers.
- Familiarity with cost accounting concepts and inventory valuation methodologies.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Shipping Information

# Shipping Information

## HOW LONG IS STANDARD AND EXPEDITED SHIPPING?

Standard: Expect to receive your order in 1-3 business days. 

Expedited: Your order typically arrives in 1-2 business days.

Business days refer to Monday - Friday and therefore does not include Saturday or Sunday as well as holidays.

## WHERE IS MY ORDER?

Once you place your order you will receive an “Order Confirmation” email from us. This email will contain all order details, including order number, shipping address, billing address, and an itemized list of all products ordered.

## WHAT ARE YOUR SHIPPING FEES?

Lower 48 US States: Free for orders $99+, $9 for orders under $99 

Alaska and Hawaii: Free for orders $129+, $19 for orders under $129

Europe: Shipping calculated at checkout

## DO YOU SHIP TO MY COUNTRY?

We currently ship all products within the U.S. and select products in the UK and Canada. To see which products are available outside the US make sure you are shopping from the correct version of our site which can be selected at the top right next to the cart icon.

## WHERE DO I ENTER MY FIRST-TIME CUSTOMER DISCOUNT CODE?

If you receive a discount code as a first time customer, you will need to enter it on the page where you choose a shipping method. The shipping page is visible after you click "Checkout" while viewing your shopping cart.

On the upper right-hand side of the page, you will see the form below that says “Gift card or discount code” and the button that says “Apply.”

Just enter your discount code in the box and click the “Apply” button. If you do not click the "Apply" button you will not receive your discount.

## CAN I CHANGE MY ORDER OR SHIPMENT ADDRESS?

Our Fulfillment team sends inbound orders to the appropriate warehouse quickly, to get your order shipped to you fast.

You can edit/update/remove items before completing your order. After this point, changes may not be not possible as the order information has already been sent to the warehouse. To see if it is possible to update your order please contact us at sales@nakednutrition.com as soon as possible.

If the wrong shipping address is entered you will be responsible for contacting the resident of the address to try and receive your order.

If you entered an address that does not exist, the order will make its way back to our fulfillment center. Upon receiving, our Fulfillment Team can then redirect your order to your correct address.

Naked Nutrition is not liable for any losses incurred if the customer has provided any incorrect details for their order. Naked Nutrition also reserves the right not to issue a refund for product costs on orders never received, as a result of the incorrect details provided.

## MY CREDIT CARD WAS CHARGED MORE THAN ONCE FOR MY ORDER

If you tried to place an order and had an issue/received an error message such as the wrong CVV code or wrong billing address and then placed a separate order, your credit card summary may show multiple authorizations.

These multiple "authorizations" are not actual charges and will be refunded back to your account shortly.

## ACCORDING TO THE TRACKING LINK MY ORDER WAS DELIVERED BUT I HAVE NOT RECEIVED ANYTHING

Before contacting us we recommend looking all over your property as the shipping carrier may have left your package in a safe location away from the view of the public.

I f you live in an apartment complex, your package may have been delivered to a parcel locker (you should have been given a key by the USPS to access the locker) or to the Leasing or complex Manager's Office.

Also note that especially during holiday times, shippers may show a package as delivered a few hours or day before it actually arrives.

# Work and Workouts Merge for the Founder of Naked Nutrition 

July 1, 2021 | Drew Limsky

Stephen Zieminski knows his market. A former college athlete, the founder of Naked Nutrition lives a disciplined life of fitness and wellness—and when he launched his business in 2014, he was banking on the hope that there were a lot of others like him. 

A Floridian through and through, Miami Beach-based Zieminski was born and raised in Sarasota, earned his B.A. and M.A. in accounting from the University of Florida’s Warrington School of Business, then went on to graduate University of Florida’s law school. To do all that takes determination, especially when you’re an All-American track star (Zieminski was also an academic All-American). 

In someone’s life, the thing you do on the side, the thing that drives you and inspires your passion, can take center stage, but it’s rare. It’s the dream of a lot of professionals. Right out of law school, Zieminski started racking up prestige jobs—senior associate at Ernst & Young, analyst at Royal Bank of Canada—but he cultivated these side projects with protein products. Eventually he traded in the water cooler for the blender, and within four months he was selling six figures a month. 

In 2020, Naked Nutrition did more than $20 million in sales. 

During the pandemic, “more people were buying online than ever before, so that was a boon to my business,” Zieminski says. “I sell online, almost exclusively.” If he says “I” instead of “we,” he’s being literal: Zieminski is the company’s only employee, having perfected a structure using contractors, agencies and vendors. 

So how did someone with a background in accounting, law and finance locate manufacturers to partner with? On that point, Zieminski is candid. “It’s a lot of trial-and-error,” he concedes. “I’ve partnered up with other firms that had more experience in the food and sports supplement development process that were able to point me to manufacturers. But back in the 2010s, that was really more on me to find outfits that would take on a brand-new company.” He explains that he’s had to source outside the state: “Very few ingredients that go into sports supplements are manufactured in Florida, unfortunately. Dairy isn’t a big thing in Florida; pea protein isn’t made in Florida. But we have the chemical components manufactured in Florida.” 

Naked Nutrition is continually adding new products and new markets, expanding into Canada, the U.K. and Europe. “We are working on relaunching our protein bars, protein cookies and multivitamins, rolling out in the next four to five months, really trying to be the company that offers products for all times of the day,” he says. “We launched Naked Shake a few months ago, a vegan protein shake that is a very easy product for people to incorporate into their lifestyles. Add water to it, shake it up, and you have a well-balanced meal.” Naked Shake represents something of a departure in terms of approach: “While earlier products were focused on simplicity of ingredients, Naked Shake has more detail, more complexity, so people will instantly like it, versus learning to love it.” 

Next on the horizon: potentially partnering with local gyms, installing smoothie bars inside. Soon, fitness buffs may be chugging Zieminski’s shakes between sets, benefitting from the fruits of his labors.

### Job Description

 About Petite Plume 

 Petite Plume is a high-growth luxury lifestyle brand rooted in timeless design, premium craftsmanship, and an unwavering dedication to comfort. We are a direct-to-consumer–led business, with a rapidly scaling DTC channel at the center of our growth and brand-building strategy. 

 Alongside our strong online presence, we maintain a selective footprint in major retail doors including Neiman Marcus, Bloomingdale's, Nordstrom, Maisonette, and Shopbop. As we continue to accelerate, we remain grounded in exceptional quality, thoughtful detail, and long-term brand vision. 

 We are building a team that is energized by growth, motivated by excellence, and excited to help shape what comes next. 

 About the Role 

 Petite Plume is seeking a hands-on Senior Accountant to serve as a key partner and primary backup to the Accounting Manager. In a lean, growing finance and accounting organization, this role will independently own significant areas of the monthly and annual close, support accurate and timely financial reporting, strengthen controls and process documentation, and help scale accounting operations across Petite Plume's e-commerce and wholesale channels. 

 The ideal candidate is a self-starter who is process-oriented, proactive, and comfortable investigating and resolving nonroutine issues, combining strong accounting judgment with a continuous-improvement mindset while preserving accuracy, confidentiality, auditability, and timely reporting. 

### Key Responsibilities 

 Close and Financial Reporting 

- Independently own assigned areas of the monthly and annual close, from source data through journal entries, reconciliations, and review-ready supporting schedules. 
- Perform balance sheet reconciliations, investigating discrepancies and aging items, resolving root causes on a timely basis. 
- Prepare account-level variance analyses and preliminary results, proactively flagging unusual trends, errors, risks, and process-improvement opportunities. 
- Maintain assigned close checklists and deadlines, escalating issues early when they could affect reporting accuracy or timing. 
- Serve as primary backup to the Accounting Manager, developing the capability to execute core close responsibilities during absences. 

 Retail and E-Commerce Accounting 

- Reconcile revenue, cash receipts, and merchant settlements across e-commerce, wholesale, and payment platforms, accounting for returns, refunds, discounts, chargebacks, fees, and revenue cutoff. 
- Support inventory and COGS accounting, including reconciliations, reserves, landed costs, freight, duties and tariffs, physical counts, and period-end cutoff. 
- Support cash, prepaid expenses, accruals, fixed assets, payroll, corporate card, and T&E accounting as assigned. 

 Controls, Processes, and Systems 

- Identify control gaps and process inefficiencies; help implement scalable solutions — including automation — that improve accuracy, timeliness, and consistency across T&E, AP, AR, and cash-application workflows. 
- Support accounting-system implementations, integrations, master-data maintenance, and data-validation efforts as needed. 

 Audit, Compliance, and Team Support 

- Own assigned audit schedules and documentation, responding to external auditor requests accurately and promptly. 
- Support tax, regulatory, and other compliance activities in coordination with internal and external partners. 
- Perform ad hoc accounting analyses and support special projects as needed. 

### Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related field. 
- 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful ownership of month-end close and general l

# Petite Plume

Petite Plume is a Retail Apparel and Fashion company. Petite Plume is a luxury pajamas and designer sleepwear company that offers soft and high-quality cotton. They provide a wide range of sleepwear for adults and kids. Petite Plume employs 75 people (+50.0% YoY, +25 people), founded in 2015. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Italy.

## About

Petite Plume was inspired by the desire to create sophisticated and comfortable sleepwear in the most exquisite cotton available. In this elegant range of sleepwear, you will see elements of classic colors and styles reminiscent of a bygone era.

The finest attention to detail can be seen throughout the range, from engraved buttons and tuck pointing to handwritten gift cards and customized packaging, making them the ideal gift. Add a monogram to make it even more memorable.

Adult sleepwear:
Our adult collection is made from 100% of the finest cotton. The fabric is preshrunk and yarn-dyed to prevent fade. The superior fabric is then brushed for added softness and gets cozier with each wash.

Children's sleepwear:
We are proud that our children's sleepwear is made with the finest quality cotton and blended with just enough inherently flame retardant fiber to allow our sleepwear to pass strict CPSC regulations without the use of harmful chemicals. The fabric is preshrunk and yarn-dyed to prevent fade. The superior fabric is then brushed for added softness and gets cozier with each wash.

Bonne nuit, ma petite plume.
